orgaos-e-sistemas/sistema-urinario/overv.descricaoOriginal: The nephron is the functional unit of the kidney. In order, structures included in a nephron are Bowman’s capsule (surrounding the glomerulus), proximal tubule (convoluted and straight portions), thin limb, and distal tubule (straight and convoluted portions). The term uriniferous tubule includes both nephron and the collecting ducts into which the nephron drains. 20x

overlays.explicacaoOriginal: The proximal tubule enters the medullary ray, where it is then called the proximal straight tubule. overlays.explicacaoOriginal: The ascending thick limb (sometimes called the distal straight tubule) continues from the thin limb and ascends through the medulla to enter a medullary ray of the cortex. Here, its cells are modified to form the macula densa of the juxtaglomerular apparatus.

overlays.explicacaoOriginal: Bowman’s capsule is a double-walled structure enclosing the glomerulus. An inner layer of cells, podocytes (visceral layer, blue arrows), surrounds the glomerular capillary and serves as part of the filtration barrier. The outer, parietal layer of the capsule (black arrows) is a simple squamous epithelium, which is continuous with the proximal convoluted tubule. Separating the layers is Bowman’s space, where the filtrate accumulates.

Urine is finally voided through the urethra.

Subsequent subdivisions are a short membranous urethra, which leads into the long penile (spongy) urethra. The penile urethra travels in the corpus spongiosum on the ventral side of the penis. 40x, 400x, 200x, 1000x (inset)

overlays.explicacaoOriginal: For most of its length, the spongy urethra is lined by a stratified columnar epithelium; however, patches of stratified squamous moist epithelium (red double arrows) are common. At its distal end, the epithelium of the spongy urethral epithelium blends with that of the glans penis to become stratified squamous.

orgaos-e-sistemas/sistema-urinario/excre.descricaoOriginal: The female urethra is much shorter than in males (3-5 cm in length), and its mucosa is thrown into longitudinal folds. The transitional epithelium present as the urethra exits the bladder transitions to stratified squamous, such as seen here. The lamina propria contains a venous plexus similar to the male corpus spongiosum. In addition to two layers of smooth muscle (inner longitudinal and outer circular), an outermost layer of circular, skeletal muscle is present at the distal end. 200x, 400x
